_note: Newest first. Add an entry here whenever the dashboard or sync code changes. Automatic data syncs are not listed.

versions.title: Cell calls count with one tag
changes: When Lisa calls a lead from her cell, she adds the "called from cell" tag. A GHL workflow stamps the time in the Cell Call Time field, and speed to lead uses it when it came before the first GHL call.
Speed-to-lead lists show these as "Measured from: Cell call (tag)".
Typing minutes in the Speed to Lead (min) field still works and takes priority.

versions.title: Speed to lead counts business-hours leads only
changes: Speed to lead (avg and median), Called within 5 min and Slow first calls now only count leads that came in during business hours (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm Eastern), as Mario asked.
After-hours leads often showed 0 min because they were called before the next opening, which made the main numbers look better than they were. Their speed is still shown in the After-hours section.
Every other number (leads, contact rate, quotes, etc.) still includes after-hours leads.

versions.title: Speed to lead: median and slow first calls
changes: New Speed to lead (median) card: the typical wait for a first call. One very slow lead can't pull it up the way it pulls up the average, so compare the two.
New Slow first calls (30+ min) card: how many leads waited more than 30 business-hours minutes for their first call. Click it for the list, slowest first, to see which leads drove the average up.
Both are in the comparison view and the trend chart, and in data/kpis.json for the KPI reports.

versions.title: Contact rate fix, after-hours leads and card summaries
changes: Contact rate only counts leads we actually reached: a connected call, a text or email reply, or Lisa's "contacted" / "showed" tag. Booking a call alone no longer counts.

New After-hours leads section: leads that come in outside Mon–Fri 9am–6pm Eastern, with their contact rate next to the business-hours contact rate, their speed to lead from the next opening, and how many got quoted. They still count in every other number.
Hover over any card for a quick summary: what it means, how it's counted, the goal and the numbers behind it.
Speed-to-lead lists show where each time came from: a GHL call, the lead calling in, or minutes Lisa entered in the "Speed to Lead (min)" field (for calls made from her cell).
"What's new" button with a dot when there's an update you haven't seen.

versions.title: Version number and change log
changes: The header shows the dashboard version. Click it to see this change log.

versions.title: Tags and dates from GHL
changes: Quotes sent, Under contract and Closed are counted on the date each one happened, using the Quote Sent Date and Contract Sent Date fields and the tags.
New tags are recognized: qualified_lead, quotes sent, under contract, showed and no show.
Show and no-show use the appointment status first, then the showed / no show tags.
Quote $ uses the Quote Amount field when it's filled in, otherwise the opportunity value.
Funnel percentages now follow one group of leads from start to finish.

versions.title: No-show tile and metric explanations
changes: Added Booked call → no-show and Booked call → show tiles.
Added plain-language explanations of how each metric is calculated.

versions.title: Period comparison
changes: New Compare button for comparing two periods, such as this week vs last week or any two custom dates.
Trend chart that shows both periods.
Added This week, Last week, This quarter and Last quarter.

versions.title: Speed-to-lead hours
changes: Speed to lead now counts business hours only: Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm Eastern.

versions.title: Voice AI
changes: Added a Voice AI section covering AI calls, call length, bookings and transfers.

versions.title: Lisa's bookings and qualification
changes: Booked calls count appointments on Lisa's calendars.
Qualified uses Lisa's qualification fields.
Speed to lead counts business hours only.
Each section has its own color.

versions.title: First release
changes: Sales KPI scorecard built from GoHighLevel data, which syncs automatically.
Click any number to see the list of leads behind it. Lead details are encrypted and only open with the team passphrase.
